newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crusader to accept offer for AQC.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crusader to accept offer for AQC.

text.p: Crusader Ltd said on Thursday it intended to accept Centennial Coal Co Ltd's 60 cents per share bid for Allied Queensland Coalfields Ltd in the absence of a higher offer.

"Crusader recognises that the offer is below the recent share price range. However, Crusader announced some time ago its intention to dispose of its 43.4 percent shareholding in AQC as part of its focus on its oil and gas businesses," Crusader said.
Centennial announced its share offer for AQC earlier on Thursday, valuing the Brisbane based coal miner at A$16.6 million. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
